title: Special Executive Programme In Global Resourcing Talent And Reward Management
description: The course aims to equip students with the knowledge to integrate talent performance with effective reward management strategies for organizational success.
longDescription: This course explores the interconnectedness between talent management, reward systems, and organizational performance. Students will learn about performance management cycles, reward management processes, and how to create systems that enhance employee engagement, retention, and development.
courseDetails: Reward management System. Design of reward system. Reward management process. Relationship with strategic planning. Impact on employee and organisational performance. Benchmark Data. Barriers to effectiveness. War for Talent and talent Types. Competency-based Management. Four Stages of Competence. Competency Architecture. Recruitment and Retention. Succession Planning and its Process The Fundamental Purposes of Reward Management. Influential Theories of Work Motivation and their implications for the Design of Reward Systems. Individual performance-related pay (PRP) systems. Contemporary approaches in Reward Management. The concept, purpose and benefits of Talent Management. The Financial Value of Talent Management. The Talent Management Process. This course provides an in-depth understanding of how reward management impacts both individual and organizational performance. It covers talent sourcing, retention strategies, competency-based management, and how to align reward systems with HR and Learning & Development (L&D) strategies. Key theories of motivation and goal setting are also discussed to help students design effective reward systems that drive organizational goals. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Relationship between Talent Performance and Reward Management: Understanding the Performance and Reward Management System: Effective Talent Sourcing and Retention: Employee Reward Management and Payment Systems: Introduction to Talent Management:
